title: P2 — Session status never transitions to 'completed': GET /v1/sessions/{id} reports "status":"active" even after the harness returned an end decision, so a Hermes-side observer cannot tell a finished session from a live one. Dogfood-verified live 2026-08-08: full tool_call->text->end loop, then GET session -> status 'active' (turn_count 3). Distinct from GAP-009 (current_decision/current_decision_type never populated; cancelled_decision_id always "") — this is the lifecycle half of session observability. Fix: processHandler/resultHandler set status=SessionCompleted when the returned decision.Decision == DecisionEnd. Pass criteria: process -> end decision -> GET session -> status 'completed'.
